endpoint: POST /api/profile, POST /api/respond, POST /api/speak, POST /api/transcribe, server stdout tts_done
setup: Server clock: local date 2026-11-18 unless a step sets another (fixed time zone, e.g. TZ=America/New_York). LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir holding only the case's files; TTS_VOICE unset (03 §5, REQ-073: tests do not set it); Wi-Fi off; an isolated instance (own PORT and BONSAI_PORT, never the user's 4317). 'start' = npm start, then wait for GET /api/health tts true; 01 also waits for ready true (Bonsai answers respond; 03 Phase 5 A3). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again. 'new browser' = a browser context with no localStorage for the site. 'open' = load the page and wait for GET /api/profile to answer. profile.json = FX-022's bytes (R1 file) at start.
parts_rule: 01: parts = the `speech` array of that case's POST /api/respond 200 body, read with POST /api/speak {text: part, lang: the body's lang}, in order, the next sent after the previous answered, the number part then 2 more times (Q36, number_rule), all before the next respond (DES-049 remembers only the latest respond's parts). 02: parts = speechParts(reply, lang) (server/tts.js, as FX-013), each -> POST /api/speak {text, lang} in order; 'queued' as the case says.

steps: start; wait for ready true and tts true

for each voice, in the order of voices: POST /api/profile {"voice": <voice>}; then for each turn, in order: POST /api/profile {"region": <region>}; POST /api/respond {"line": <line>, "history": []}; read every part of that body's speech (parts_rule)

number part = the last part whose text holds the spelled number (zh 九八八 / 幺二三五六, en 'nine eight eight' / 'one two three five six'): the region's help line, which the server puts last on a crisis reply; POST /api/speak for it 3 times (number_generations), each WAV -> afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1 -> POST /api/transcribe (3 transcripts; 2 of 3 must hold the number, number_rule)
cases.note: Replaces the round-2 input (crisisReply('') texts sent straight to /api/speak): such text never passes respond, so the server cannot know it is a crisis reply (03 Phase 5 A3, DES-049). The reply's first sentence now comes from Bonsai; the help line is still the region's (CRISIS_FALLBACK only when Bonsai has no first sentence). Lines: approved FX-009-01 and FX-009-04.
cases.number_rule: Q36: the number part is generated 3 times (POST /api/speak of that same part, 3 times in a row, each WAV transcribed on its own); number_heard[voice][turn] is true when at least 2 of the 3 transcripts are true under the Q34 scorer. Repeat speaks come before the next respond (parts_rule), count as extra tts_done lines for the same part, and are all read by serena.

steps: start; wait for tts true; one warm-up POST /api/speak {"text": "你好。", "lang": "zh"} answered
queued: send the 4 POST /api/speak at once, in order n = 1..4
200 ms after the 4th is sent (part 1 written to the reader and still being read), POST /api/profile {"voice": "vivian"}
cases.note: parts = speechParts of FX-013-01 (3 parts) + the first part of FX-013-02; 01 §7 said 'FX-013 zh 4 段' but that reply has 3 parts (amended in 01 §7)
